empty.title: This queue is empty.
empty.body: Decisions land here when they match the queue's rules or an agent adds them.

noMatch.title: No decisions match your search or filters.
noMatch.body: Adjust or clear your search and filters to see the rest.

aging.label: Aging
aging.body: Idle past {{days}} days — kept off the queue. Keep any you still want surfaced.

seed.bodyOn: This queue fills itself automatically. Decisions are added the moment they match any of its rules:
seed.bodyOff: Automatic adds are paused. These rules would add decisions to the queue when on:
seed.noteOn: Turning it off stops new automatic adds only — decisions already here stay, and you can still add or remove decisions by hand.
seed.noteOff: Adding or removing decisions by hand still works while automatic seeding is off.
